name: @payswap/merchant-crypto
description: Merchant crypto payment contracts on canonical PaySwap payment primitives: crypto acceptance policy (assets/chains/constraints/expiry), exact crypto quotes, PaymentIntent/PaymentAttempt/CheckoutSession mappings onto the canonical payment and settlement planes, settlement destination route families (native Stripe crypto settlement kept DISTINCT from PaySwap external conversion/off-ramp settlement), and the two settlement capability definitions (Work Order P4-W1-003)
